split_rules: Assign task aliases and decision slots before outcomes; no continuation-level random splitting.
New states from seen tasks require independently seeded discovery, disjoint trajectories and distinct pre-action input fingerprints, plus an accepted training state from the same task.
Previously inspected 124 diagnostic task groups are training-only; historical 3/5-draw records remain a separate diagnostic cohort for the first fit.
All actions, draws and retries stay with their state. Unseen-task validation and locked test hold out entire task groups.
Unseen refers to the new selector fit, not guaranteed backbone or actor pretraining exclusion.
Protected benchmark, retention and near-duplicate screening must finish before production release.
Depth-slot and role admission may depend on replay checks but never continuation successes, ties or teacher preference.

collection_protocol.replay: unchanged strict observable-state checks; all forty isolated contexts ready before candidate dispatch
collection_protocol.candidate_intervention: full sampled response including reasoning/action in continuation history

selector_fit.target: five candidate success counts divided by eight committed draws
selector_fit.loss: mean independent sigmoid/binomial BCE on the five candidate index logits at a fixed output prefix
selector_fit.primary_invalid_handling: committed invalid outcomes count zero, matching the operational-success comparison; missing/unresolved records never fabricated as labels
selector_fit.secondary: valid-only sensitivity with valid denominators and failure reasons; not a replacement primary estimand
selector_fit.input: pre-action goal, screenshot, allowed causal history and fixed candidate panel only
selector_fit.implementation_status: loss adapter and GPU parity/save-reload validation still required
selector_fit.interpretation: outcome adaptation of a teacher-pretrained selector, not purely outcome-only pretraining

evaluation.primary: mean continuation success of the learned selected action, separately on seen-task/new-state and unseen-task validation
evaluation.oracle_reference: select using first six draws; score fresh final two; tie-break without held-out outcomes
evaluation.uncertainty: resample whole task groups; preserve paired states, candidates and draws
evaluation.checkpoint_selection: validation only, with selected-checkpoint validation scores labeled selection-biased; final locked task test untouched
evaluation.controls: No claim of superiority over matched teacher-label training without that additional training control. Frozen judge semantic limitations remain.

pilot_request.admission_gate: validate forty-context resource ownership and strict replay before scaling; reserve budget for a whole group and cleanup
pilot_request.zero_yield_stop: pause for diagnosis if first 24 resolved replay groups have zero accepted states; not a statistical proof of infeasibility
pilot_request.retries: charge all failed/rejected attempts and retain first-cause evidence; no full-budget reset

feasibility.warning: Eight-draw all-context acceptance is unmeasured. Three slots on 2090 tasks provide 5709 collectible opportunities, not 1500 guaranteed states. Expand audited source coverage or slots only after role/depth-specific pilot yield and cost review.
feasibility.larger_source_pool_status: metadata available; requires separate exclusions/source audit and budget approval
